title: Faithfulness Before Fruit
headline: What to Do While You Wait on God
tagline: Harvest belongs to God. Faithfulness belongs to us.
seo_title: What to Do While You Wait on God: Faithfulness Before Fruit | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Most men spend their waiting season asking when God will move. The better question: how can I be faithful today? A devotional on Luke 16:10.
verse_text: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much.

scriptures.text: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much.
Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord….

items: Most men spend their waiting season asking:
“When will God move?”
The better question is:
“How can I be faithful today?”
Because harvest belongs to God.
Faithfulness belongs to us.
God rarely asks us to produce fruit.
He asks us to remain connected to the Vine.
Instead of focusing on what hasn’t happened yet….
Ask:
Where can I be faithful today?
Who can I encourage today?
What responsibility can I steward well today?
What obedience have I already been given?

blocks.text: Waiting is never wasted when you’re walking in obedience.

items: Waiting becomes miserable when our eyes stay on tomorrow.
Waiting becomes meaningful when our hands stay busy with today’s assignment.
Jesus,
Teach me not to waste this season longing for tomorrow while neglecting today’s obedience.
Help me remain faithful in small things.
Help me honor You in hidden places.
May I be known more for my faithfulness than my impatience.
Amen.
Today I choose faithfulness over frustration.
Obedience over urgency.
Stewardship over striving.
I trust God with tomorrow.
I will be faithful today.

blocks.text: Many men miss tomorrow’s harvest because they become unfaithful in today’s field.
